messages:
Anya W: quick sync — we need to lock MVP for the observability console features for next release. Must pick minimal set for dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. propose: dashboards (api routes + model-level latency), traces sampling for error paths, cost breakdown by model+route, error grouping basic. can we ship that by EOW?
Mike L.: EOW is tight. Need clarity on data model. Do we keep metric pipeline or add new event store?
Sophia R.: leaning toward using existing metrics pipeline for latency histograms; traces should be separate (jaeger-style) with sampling. I'll sketch PR.
Kevin C.: FYI error grouping requires fingerprinting heuristics. naive grouping will explode signal. propose: stage 1: group by exception message + model name, stage 2: add stack/hash.
Anya W: decision: scope-cut so we can hit M1. MVP items: 1) dashboards - latency + token cost per route, 2) error analytics - grouped by message + model, 3) traces - error-only sampling + link to request id, 4) cost breakdown - daily model+route table. Non-MVP: per-token heatmaps, full trace replay.
Mike L.: acceptance criteria? SLOs + runbook.
Anya W.: Acceptance: dashboards show 95th/avg latency per route; cost table matches billing within 3%; error grouping reduces noise (<= 20% false group rate estimated); traces surface id and sample rate. Also need consent/privacy check for PII.
Sophia R.: notes on sampling config:
``
traces_sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01
  error_rate: 1.0
  overrides:
    - route: /chat
      rate: 0.05
```
Kevin C.: instrumentation todo: add trace_id to response header, add token counts to metrics emit, add model_version tag.
obs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pulls/4921 — draft for dashboard schema.
Anya W.: next steps: Mike -> final schema by Tue, Kevin -> instrumentation PR by Wed, Sophia -> trace ingestion prototype by Thu. I'll book a 15m sync Fri to sign off.
Mike L.: ok. flagging risk: cost calc depends on sampling decimation math. we should add fallback: daily reconcile job.
Anya W.: noted, add to acceptance checklist. Thanks all :tada:
